notes:
- The profile banner stays inside its own frame: the picture is drawn at its own size and clipped to its own box, so the crop, the position and the drift can only move the artwork across the artwork instead of sliding it out of the banner.
- A long activity title stays inside its card: the marquee is clipped to the row that owns it, so a scrolling title no longer paints past the card's rounded edge and into the page margin.
- The activity feed spells progress once: a progress line that already carries "Ep." or "Ch" is no longer prefixed a second time, and a long status pill ellipsizes.
- The comment composer keeps its reply target: clearing the "replying to" chip clears the highlighted comment with it, and an expanded text post survives rotation.
- The activity heatmap holds the reader's place: the calendar opens at the newest week once instead of on every refresh, gutter taps are ignored, the selected day can be cleared, and the Week bars are announced to a screen reader.
- A like lands in one place: a refused like now rolls back only its own state, the count beside a heart opens the likers list, those rows open a profile, and a like that lands gets one short pop.
